text: Operations on ST 81, OCS-G-27155, Well A-1 to restore production from the existing "O" Sand perforations, 19268' - 19358' MD were completed, but proved unsuccessful.  Coil tubing was used to pump a scale treatment into the formation, which allowed the fish located @ 19212' MD to fall downhole and re-expose the "O" Sand perfs to production.  However, the A-1 well only produced water and is currently shut-in.  Operations began on January 19, 2010 and ended on January 23, 2010.

The sleeve to access the M53 reservoir was shifted open (M55/M54 closed) on 8/4/14 to obtain14 days of flowing information of the sand and a sample of the M53 fluids for compatibility analysis.
